parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of laminated particle board, forming the front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the access point to the cabinet’s interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and door, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf inside the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items, dividing the cabinet’s interior into sections for organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf inside the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and supports heavier items placed at the bottom.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
